newsitem.title: UK: Tunstall shares slide on profits warning.
newsitem.headline: Tunstall shares slide on profits warning.

text.p: Tunstall Group Plc, the alarm and emergency communications firm, said on Wednesday its full year profits will be only half those achieved a year ago because of losses at its subsidiary Mion Electronics and the strength of sterling.
Tunstall's share slid 34 pence to 85 pence on the news.

Following reviews of financial records and manufacturing standards held on the standard costing system, it is necessary to adjust Mion's accounts by just over 1.0 million stg for the year to date, Tunstall said in a statement.

"While these measures will ensure greater management control in future, as a result of the adjustments....Mion Electronics is expected to make a loss in the current year of 600,000 stg, whilst returning to profitability next year," Tunstall said.
Tunstall issued a warning in March saying that group profit for the year to September 30, 1997 was expected to be below that achieved last year.
In the year to September 30, 1996, Tunstall reported pre-tax profits of 8.2 million stg.
